name: io.github.jayjodev/vivory-mcp-korea
title: Vivory Korea Data Gateway
description: Umbrella MCP server bundling 51 tools across 14 official Korean public-data sources (KOSIS · BOK · DART · KMA · AirKorea · Opinet · HIRA · NMC · MOLIT · KTO · MFDS · MOIS · NEIS · Seoul OpenData). All responses normalized to English JSON with source attribution. No upstream API keys required.

environmentVariables.name: VIVORY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Vivory Pro API key for higher daily limits (10,000/day Pro vs 100/day anonymous). Get one at api.vivory.app/dashboard/api-keys.

environmentVariables.name: VIVORY_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the upstream gateway URL (default: https://api.vivory.app/api). Useful for self-hosted Vivory backends.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.upstream_data_license: KOGL Type 1 (open with attribution, commercial use OK)
